description: Shortest chain of outbound citations from one document to another (e.g. how a judgment reaches a directive), optionally over filtered edges only. found: false is a normal answer, not an error. Cost: 20 credits.

from.description: Start identifier: a CELEX number, or a national document id, e.g. "AT-NOR-12345".

includeNational.description: Add national documents of live countries (BUSINESS+).

jurisdictions.description: Neighbours in: "eu" and/or live national codes (national: BUSINESS+).

provenance.description: Edge origins (cellar-nim: a notified measure, not a finding of transposition). The last three: 400 while no country is live.

to.description: Target identifier: a CELEX number, or a national document id, e.g. "AT-NOR-12345".

name: lex_citation_path
title: Citation path between two documents
